text:
mira: Ran a quick canary for ar/ja/zh on sirocco-v2 q4f (int8). Seeing concentrated detok/ligature failures when ZWJ (U+200D) or hair-space (U+200A) appear near punctuation.

mira: Quick metrics: ja BLEU 22.7 (-3.1), zh BLEU 29.0 (-0.5), ar BLEU 17.1 (-4.0). Flags show ~65% of AR failures involve ZWJ/hair-space.

eva: Can you drop 8 minimal repros (input, int8 output, token id traces)? I want to add to the harness and compute token-substitution matrices.

mira: Uploading a small bundle to S3 now (will paste link). Minimal AR example: Input: "البيت‍ال" -> Output int8: broken ligature, extra ascii space inserted.

devon: We recently folded several zero-width variants into a compact remap for q4f to shrink vocab. If remap was applied inconsistently between encode/decode or the KVC packing path, adjacent token ids could shift.

kai: @eval-bot run a focused compare: sirocco-v2 fp32 vs q4f on ZWJ/hair-space slices. Token-diff and per-sample mirror checks please.

eval-bot: Compare queued: compare-1768200000. Link: https://ci.redwood/sirocco/compare/1768200000

devon: Quick triage steps: 1) run q4f with remap_passthrough=true, 2) run with kernel=fp32-emulate, 3) disable prefix cache as a guard (cache_affinity=off). That should isolate remap vs numeric vs KV-indexing.

mira: Will run those now and post token traces. If remap_passthrough removes most failures, we should temporarily disable folding for canary.

eva: If confirmed, add a canary gate: fail if ZWJ/hair-space substitution rate > 1% or BLEU delta on the mini-suite > 2.5. I'll add synthetic tests to the harness too.

eval-bot: Compare finished: AR BLEU -3.9, JA BLEU -3.0. 58/90 ZWJ/hair-space anomalies flagged. Results: https://ci.redwood/sirocco/compare/1768200000/results

mira: Remap_passthrough run reduces anomalies drastically (JA delta -0.7, AR delta -0.8). fp32-emulate helps a bit but less so. Looks like remap folding inconsistency is main culprit.

devon: I'll audit the remap serialization and KVC packing immediately. Plan: revert folding in remap for q4f canary and prepare a fix for remap table application.

kai: Good. Ping infra if you need a quick staging config flip. :thumbsup:

mira: Will follow up after audit with recommended canary config.
